# Background & aims

# Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

austraits <-
  readRDS(file = "downloads//austraits//austraits-7.0.0.rds") |>
  austraits::flatten_database()
```

```{r}
nrow(austraits)

x <- austraits |>
  group_by(taxon_name, trait_name) |>
  count()


data_grid <- expand_grid(taxon_name = austraits$taxon_name |> unique(), trait_name = austraits$trait_name |> unique()) |>
  left_join(x) |>
  mutate(n = replace_na(n, 0))

data_trait_counts <- data_grid |>
  group_by(trait_name) |>
  summarise(n_spp = sum(n > 0), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(desc(n_spp)) |>
  left_join(austraits |> select(trait_name, unit) |> distinct()) |>
  mutate(type = ifelse(is.na(unit), "categorical", "numeric")) |> 
  group_by(type) |> mutate(rank = row_number())  |>
  ungroup()

data_trait_counts |>
ggplot(aes(rank, n_spp, group = type, col = type)) +
geom_line() +
xlim(c(0, 100)) +
theme_minimal() +
labs(
  title = "Coverage by taxa in Austraits v7.0.0",
  x = "Rank",
  y = "Number of taxa"
)

ggsave("outputs/coverage.png", width = 5, height =3)
```

Top ten

```{r}
data_trait_counts |>
  filter(type == "numeric") |>
  slice_max(n_spp, n = 10) |> pull(trait_name) |>
  paste(collapse = ", ")

data_trait_counts |>
  filter(type == "categorical") |>
  slice_max(n_spp, n = 10) |> pull(trait_name) |>
  paste(collapse = ", ")


```
